messages.不支持此文件类型。请选择图片、PDF、Word、文本或表格。: Unsupported file type. Choose an image, PDF, Word document, text file, or spreadsheet.
messages.每个附件不能超过 10 MB。: Each attachment must be 10 MB or smaller.
messages.每次最多添加 5 个附件。: Attach up to 5 files per message.
messages.附件总大小不能超过 25 MB。: Attachments must total 25 MB or less.
messages.附件尚未确认接收，已保留供重试。: Attachment upload was not confirmed. Your files are kept for retry.
messages.附件包含无法作为文本读取的二进制内容。: The attachment contains binary data that cannot be read as text.
messages.无法识别附件文字编码，请另存为 UTF-8 后上传。: The attachment's text encoding is not recognized. Save it as UTF-8 and upload again.
messages.图片附件仅支持 JPEG、PNG 和 WebP。: Image attachments support JPEG, PNG, and WebP only.
messages.图片像素过大，请缩小后再上传。: The image dimensions are too large. Resize it and upload again.
messages.无法读取图片附件，请上传有效的 JPEG、PNG 或 WebP。: The image could not be read. Upload a valid JPEG, PNG, or WebP file.
messages.无法读取加密的 PDF 附件，请先取消密码保护。: The encrypted PDF cannot be read. Remove its password protection first.
messages.PDF 附件页数过多，请拆分文件后上传。: The PDF has too many pages. Split it and upload again.
messages.扫描或图片 PDF 需要启用支持图片的多模态模型。: Scanned or image-based PDFs require a model with image support.
messages.扫描 PDF 附件最多支持 8 页，请拆分后上传；未忽略后续页面。: Scanned PDF attachments support up to 8 pages. Split the file and upload again; later pages have not been silently omitted.
messages.包含图片的 PDF 附件最多支持 8 页，请拆分后上传；未忽略图片内容。: PDF attachments containing images support up to 8 pages. Split the file and upload again; image content has not been silently omitted.
messages.无法读取 PDF 附件，请确认文件未损坏。: The PDF could not be read. Check that the file is not damaged.
messages.每条消息最多上传 5 个附件。: Upload up to 5 attachments per message.
messages.每条消息的附件合计不能超过 25 MB。: Attachments per message must total 25 MB or less.
messages.附件文件名无效或过长。: The attachment filename is invalid or too long.
messages.附件支持 JPEG、PNG、WebP、PDF、DOCX、TXT、Markdown: Attachments support JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, Excel, and CSV/TSV.
messages.图片附件需要启用支持图片的多模态模型。: Image attachments require a model with image support.
messages.附件文字合计超过 120000 字符，请拆分发送或上传到知识库后查询。: Attachment text exceeds 120,000 characters. Send smaller files separately or upload them to a knowledge base for querying.
messages.每条消息最多包含 8 张图片或 PDF 页面，请拆分发送。: Each message supports up to 8 images or PDF pages. Split them across messages.
messages.此会话附件已超过 20 个，请新建对话后继续上传。: This conversation exceeds 20 attachments. Start a new conversation to upload more.
messages.此会话附件文字合计超过 120000 字符，请新建对话；已保存的附件未被省略。: Attachment text in this conversation exceeds 120,000 characters. Start a new conversation; saved attachments have not been omitted.
messages.此会话包含图片或视觉 PDF 附件，请启用支持图片的多模态模型后继续。: This conversation contains images or visual PDF attachments. Enable a model with image support to continue.
messages.此会话图片和 PDF 页面合计超过 16 张，请新建对话；已保存的图片未被省略。: This conversation exceeds 16 images and PDF pages. Start a new conversation; saved images have not been omitted.
messages.附件只能关联到用户消息。: Attachments can only belong to user messages.
messages.附件引用无效，请重新上传。: The attachment reference is invalid. Upload the file again.
messages.附件已删除或无权访问，请重新上传。: The attachment was deleted or is inaccessible. Upload it again.
messages.附件所属会话已不可访问。: The attachment's conversation is no longer accessible.
messages.附件文件已变化，请重新上传。: The attachment file has changed. Upload it again.
messages.附件文件已删除、损坏或发生变化，请重新上传。: The attachment file was deleted, damaged, or changed. Upload it again.
messages.此会话包含图片附件，请启用支持图片的多模态模型后继续。: This conversation contains image attachments. Enable a model with image support to continue.
messages.此会话包含扫描 PDF，请启用支持图片的多模态模型后继续。: This conversation contains scanned PDFs. Enable a model with image support to continue.
messages.扫描 PDF 页数已变化，请重新上传。: The scanned PDF page count has changed. Upload it again.
messages.无法呈现扫描 PDF 附件，请重新上传。: The scanned PDF could not be rendered. Upload it again.
messages.每条附件消息最多支持 5 个附件，请重新发送。: Each attachment message supports up to 5 files. Send it again with fewer files.
messages.附件消息原文无效，请重新发送。: The original attachment message is invalid. Send it again.
messages.附件消息无法保存为持久会话，请重新发送。: The attachment message could not be saved in conversation history. Send it again.
messages.附件来源已变化，请重新上传。: The attachment source has changed. Upload it again.
messages.附件来源标识或内容已变化，请重新上传。: The attachment source ID or content has changed. Upload it again.
messages.附件来源已删除、变化或无权访问。: The attachment source was deleted, changed, or is inaccessible.
messages.可添加照片或文件，仅用于本次对话；最多 5 个，每个 10 MB，总计 25 M: Attach photos or files for this conversation: up to 5 files, 10 MB each, 25 MB total.

patterns.source: 附件「{name}」超过 80000 字符的对话上下文上限，请拆分文件或上传到知识库后查询。
patterns.target: Attachment “{name}” exceeds the 80,000-character chat context limit. Split it or upload it to a knowledge base for querying.

patterns.source: 附件「{name}」没有可读取的内容。
